description: Java source file defining a utility class 'Projector' for projecting 3D objects onto 2D screen coordinates using OpenGL ES in an Android context. It includes methods for setting view parameters, projecting points, and retrieving current projection/modelview matrices.

classes.name: Projector
classes.description: A utility class for projecting 3D points to 2D screen coordinates and retrieving current projection and modelview matrices using OpenGL ES.

methods.name: Projector
methods.description: Constructor initializing projection matrix, view vector, and MatrixGrabber.

methods.name: setCurrentView
methods.description: Sets the current view parameters including position and size.

methods.name: project
methods.description: Projects a 3D object coordinate to window coordinate using the current matrix transformations.

methods.name: getCurrentProjection
methods.description: Retrieves the current projection matrix from OpenGL and flags that the MVP needs recomputation.

methods.name: getCurrentModelView
methods.description: Retrieves the current modelview matrix from OpenGL and flags that the MVP needs recomputation.
